name: Commercial Contact Portrait Library
description: Identity-neutral portrait series derived from the deterministic Stage 8 visual-trait generator. A portrait is a reusable visual asset, not the identity of the person currently using it. Current Koplin commercial contacts 0001-0100 use the corresponding portrait indices, while a future generated universe may assign the same visual assets to entirely different people.
constraints: Do not bake personal names into the image.
Do not bake company names or readable logos into the image.
Do not bake registration numbers or universe-specific text into the image.
The stored per-person image prompt is the current materialisation prompt for the corresponding visual asset index.
